title: Middleton Shopping Centre's rooftop fireworks hailed 'best display in years'
excerpt: Middleton Shopping Centre fired a huge fireworks display from its roof to close the town's Christmas lights switch-on, set to Mariah Carey's All I Want for Christmas Is You.
body:
Middleton Shopping Centre ended the town's Christmas lights switch-on tonight, Saturday 14 November, with a huge fireworks display fired from the roof of the building.

The display was set to Mariah Carey's All I Want for Christmas Is You.

People who watched it described it as "absolutely amazing" and "the best display in years".

The fireworks followed the switch-on in Middleton Gardens, which was scheduled for 6.30pm.

The day's programme began at noon with food and drink, fairground rides and market stalls, including the Teenage Market.

Community groups and Middleton Brass Band were on the bill, with personalised Christmas card making from the Art House and face painting.

Tribute act The Golden Era of K-POP was booked for a performance and meet-and-greet from 5.30pm, before the main event.

Broadcaster Michelle Eagleton was hosting again, joined by members of the cast of Cinderella, the pantomime at Middleton Arena from 26 November.

Middleton Shopping Centre has helped fund the town's switch-on in previous years.

Source: accounts from people who attended and the published event programme.
